from pyscipopt import Model
m=Model()
x=m.addVar(vtype="B",obj=1.0)
m.setRealParam("gaprel",0.0005)
m.setMinimize(False)
m.optimize()
assert abs(m.getObjVal()-1.0)<1e-8
print("objective",m.getObjVal(),"status",m.getStatus())
